verdict.rationale: Navan documents an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials flow for its API, so programmatic credentials for an agent can be issued. However, nothing in the evidence shows scopes, per-resource permissions, or least-privilege controls on those credentials, or how MCP connections are permissioned. missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or permission granularity, read-only vs write credential options, agent-specific credential management or revocation, independent corroboration.
